Container.Name: Savorly
Container.Overview: A calm, self-hosted weekly meal planner with calorie and protein goals, recipe discovery, one-pot meal prep, and automatic shopping lists.
Container.Requires: Internet access is required for USDA, TheMealDB, and remote recipe images.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port used to open Savorly in your browser.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent meal plans, recipes, ratings, and settings.

Config.Name: USDA API Key
Config.Description: Optional FoodData Central key. Leave blank to use the limited USDA demo key.

Config.Name: TheMealDB API Key
Config.Description: The free personal/development key is 1. Replace it with a supporter key if applicable.
